metadata.description: Lineage, a cooperative family documentation and research platform, and the factory that generates source-to-output pipelines like it.

plugins.name: lineage
plugins.description: A family's recordings, photographs, documents and public records turned into a sourced, browsable record (genealogy, timeline, Familypedia), with stories, a printed book and narration as exports.

plugins.name: factory
plugins.description: Generate a source-to-output pipeline with citations, units, bridges, gates and versioning for a new domain.
